answer: Canyon-echo attestation. Each agent embeds a secret "marble" token in its outputs—a juniper-scented nonce derived from its private key and timestamp. Peers sample outputs and verify the nonce chain; duplicated identities must reuse the same token stream, so independent verifiers detect correlated echoes across supposedly distinct agents. Attacker cost: generating genuinely independent nonce histories per fake identity, plus maintaining distinct behavioral traces, scales linearly with sybil count.
